tools.name: trust_status
tools.description: Server health + data provenance: index build time, source recompute checks, verdict/receipt/anchor counts, mainnet vs testnet posture. Call this first to judge freshness.

tools.name: trust_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a Herald receipt hash: recomputed hash match, the record it belongs to, issuer, anchor state (ANCHORED/PENDING/FAILED/NOT_ENQUEUED) with chain + tx + proof bundle, offline proof verification, and a verify_recipe. Unknown hash returns typed NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: trust_get_bench_verdict
tools.description: The current Verity bench verdict for a product, byte-verbatim with scope attached, plus the computed pointer block. No verdict returns typed NO_VERDICT.

tools.name: trust_get_validation_record
tools.description: Resolve an ERC-8004 Validation Registry record by validation_id, request_hash, or product. Testnet records are labelled TESTNET; mainnet lookups return typed NOT_PUBLISHED_MAINNET.

tools.name: trust_resolve_agent
tools.description: Resolve an agent by ERC-8004 agent_id, DID, or registration URL: registration summary plus a trust summary computed from the records at call time.
